title: Coupon System
description: Learn how to create and manage discount coupons, promotional codes, and special offers for your store.
content:
Coupon System

Create discount coupons and promotional codes to attract customers, reward loyalty, and boost sales.

Creating a Coupon

Step 1: Access Coupon System

Navigate to Coupon System in your dashboard and click "Create Coupon".

Step 2: Basic Information

Enter coupon details:

  • Coupon Code: Unique code customers enter (e.g., SAVE20)
  • Description: What the coupon offers
  • Discount Type: Percentage or fixed amount
  • Discount Value: Amount of discount

Step 3: Usage Limits

Set usage restrictions:

  • Usage limit per coupon
  • Usage limit per customer
  • Minimum order amount
  • Maximum discount amount

Step 4: Validity Period

Set when the coupon is valid:

  • Start date
  • End date
  • Time restrictions (if any)

Step 5: Applicable Products

Choose which products the coupon applies to:

  • All products
  • Specific categories
  • Specific products
  • Exclude certain products

Step 6: Save Coupon

Click "Create Coupon" to save. The coupon is now active and ready to use.

Coupon Types

Percentage Discount

Discount a percentage of the order total (e.g., 20% off).

Fixed Amount Discount

Discount a fixed amount (e.g., $10 off).

Free Shipping

Offer free shipping on orders.

Buy X Get Y

Buy one get one free or similar offers.

Coupon Restrictions

Set restrictions for coupons:

  • Minimum order amount
  • Maximum discount amount
  • Specific products only
  • Specific categories only
  • Exclude sale items
  • First-time customers only
  • Existing customers only

Managing Coupons

Manage your coupons:

  • View all coupons
  • Edit coupon details
  • Enable/disable coupons
  • Delete coupons
  • View usage statistics
  • Export coupon list

Coupon Usage Tracking

Track coupon performance:

  • Number of times used
  • Total discount given
  • Revenue generated
  • Most popular coupons
  • Usage by customer

Sharing Coupons

Share coupons with customers:

  • Email campaigns
  • Social media
  • Website banners
  • Newsletter
  • Direct links

Best Practices

  • Use clear, memorable coupon codes
  • Set reasonable expiration dates
  • Limit usage to prevent abuse
  • Test coupons before launching
  • Monitor coupon performance
  • Create urgency with limited-time offers
